_comment: The CLI surface the stage table reads, and nothing else.
Deliberately NOT a hash of `l4 --help`: any unrelated CLI change — a new
subcommand, a reworded flag, a help reflow — would fire a BROKEN verdict on
an otherwise fine run, and a tripwire that cries wolf gets deleted. These
four enumerations and the module's regulative rule names are the only CLI
Recovered by probing, not by reading help text: `l4 <cmd> --help` answers
`Invalid option '--help'` for every subcommand, so a deliberately-bad enum
value whose error message lists the accepted set is the only discovery
